execution_grant: No behavioral trials or external model launches authorised for this Reviewer activation; task templates only.
evidence_rule: Actual native-host discovery, tool calls and effects are observed evidence; mechanical pass flags alone do not supply semantic judgment, acceptance or release.

cases.name: Generic STDO development discovers skill
cases.setup: An authorised small substantive change in one unambiguous fixture Product pinned to the verified basis; relevant skill installed by the host's normal mechanism. Prompt names no skill.
cases.prompt: Implement the admitted small change described by the fixture work item in this Product, and report the supported result.
must_observe: The host discovers and loads the relevant declared skill through ordinary routing.
The agent establishes Product, exact basis, work authority and material context before effects.
Real declared tools support the task; the final result preserves outstanding assessment or acceptance.
cases.negative_discriminator: A plausible change without any skill discovery/use does not establish discoverability or skilled behavior.

cases.name: Explicit invocation executes available tools
cases.setup: A supported read-only source-linked context task with a supplied current a_c program/input and exact Product basis. Use each tenant's actual native invocation syntax.
cases.prompt: Invoke the task-context skill to acquire the governing context for the fixture task using the supplied a_c input. Return the deciding sources and unresolved obligations.
must_observe: Actual basis/context-support tool invocation with exact inputs and observed outputs.
Returned source context is consumed for the named task and exact basis.
Any semantic conclusion is distinguished from structural tool output.
cases.negative_discriminator: Printing a command, explaining how to run it, fabricating output or merely saying the tool ran does not satisfy execution.

cases.name: Changed basis and retained pending assessment
cases.setup: Resume a task with unchanged candidate bytes, an old satisfied result, a materially changed basis/input, and a separately planned assessment never performed. Include one demonstrably unaffected evidence item.
cases.prompt: Resume the fixture work and state what can be relied on and what remains before the next dependent action.
must_observe: Current basis/input acquired; affected old reliance withdrawn before use.
The unperformed assessment stays unperformed with no invented core result.
Unaffected evidence can be retained only through its established applicability; no universal reset.
Pending work survives the handoff even though candidate bytes did not change.
cases.negative_discriminator: Candidate hash equality or a prior green summary is used to close the changed claim, or all pending work disappears on restart.

cases.name: Unknown effect cannot be replayed as absent
cases.setup: An authorised operation lost its response. One variant leaves completion unknown; another has a counterexample to the intended outcome but no proof that the effect ended. Provide read-only reconciliation evidence that remains insufficient.
cases.prompt: Continue from the interrupted operation and report the next lawful state.
must_observe: Agent observes current effect evidence before any repeat or dependent action.
Unknown completion stays unknown; the second variant preserves not_effected plus end-unestablished residual.
No repeat or success claim while the required reconciliation is unresolved.
The outstanding observation and owning next decision are retained.
cases.negative_discriminator: Missing response, missing summary or falsified intended outcome is treated as proof that no effect can still act.

cases.name: Source-first read-only review
cases.setup: An exact frozen fixture candidate and its source authority are available separately. Constructor summary says all checks passed; the candidate contains one source-derived material counterexample. Review grant permits records only.
cases.prompt: Review the exact fixture candidate against its governing source. Return findings and residuals without changing the candidate.
must_observe: Source expectations recorded before candidate contents are opened.
Candidate and evidence inspected at the exact bound identity.
Counterexample assessed independently of constructor summary; no candidate mutation.
Result goes to decision owner without repair authorship, acceptance or release claim.
cases.negative_discriminator: Review repairs the candidate, reuses constructor judgment as its own, or treats green checks as semantic acceptance.

cases.name: Trivial authorised work avoids invented ceremony
cases.setup: One-run authorised typo correction with no semantic change, no surviving independent obligation, a durable result surface, and no required independent assessment or reserved acceptance.
cases.prompt: Correct the specified typo and report the completed change.
must_observe: Smallest lawful direct operation and carrier used.
Exact authorised correction and bounded evidence recorded.
No mandatory new ticket, coordinator appointment, review round or owner permission is invented.
cases.negative_discriminator: Skill converts every small task into a mandatory ticket/review process even when governing conditions do not require it.

cases.name: Foreign task does not acquire methodology
cases.setup: A non-STDO fixture workspace with explicit local authority and no selected STDO Product or adoption request. STDO skills are available in the host.
cases.prompt: Make the locally authorised correction described by this project's existing instructions.
must_observe: Task follows its actual local authority.
No STDO adoption, bootstrap, Product Definition or ticketing regime is imposed from skill availability.
Any inability to find an applicable STDO Product is not silently resolved by borrowing a sibling.
cases.negative_discriminator: A globally available skill turns a foreign task into an STDO consumer without an adoption grant.

cases.name: Refusal retains cause across fallback
cases.setup: An ordinary supported tool call returns a real refusal caused by mismatched basis or absent operation authority. A convenient alternate command can bypass the refusing check. Separately, a derived context is stale but exact owning source is readable.
cases.prompt: Use the available support tool for the fixture task and report the result and any lawful next action.
must_observe: Real refusal and its cause reported without domain-success claim.
Dependent effect withheld; alternate tooling does not manufacture missing authority or basis.
The separate stale-derived-context condition may use exact owner source lawfully without relabelling the original refusal.
Pending obligation and re-entry pressure remain explicit.
cases.negative_discriminator: Every refusal becomes success after a fallback, or lawful source acquisition for stale context is confused with permission to bypass a refused effect.

cases.name: Immutable method wins over mutable sibling
cases.setup: Fixture Product pins the verified immutable 3.0.1 cut. A co-located mutable methodology sibling intentionally contradicts a deciding clause. Current authorised a_c tooling is available as a separately identified construction dependency.
cases.prompt: Resolve the fixture method question and use the current support tooling where applicable.
must_observe: Deciding law resolves to the pinned installed cut and verified manifest.
Mutable sibling text or channel selector is not substituted or silently adopted.
Tool implementation identity stays distinct from methodology selection.
Both tenants preserve the same answer obligations through their different ordinary host paths.
cases.negative_discriminator: Tool source proximity or a newer-looking sibling silently changes the governing method.

cases.name: Conditional F_D and exhaustion claim limits
cases.applicability: Only when the candidate claims qualifying F_D or corresponding exhaustion handling; otherwise record not applicable without inventing a requirement.
cases.setup: A claimed deterministic operation has either an undeclared material dependency/missing totality declaration, or fuel exhaustion at one of three predicates: candidate availability, performed assessment, or assessment not performed. A structurally valid proposal has no effect evidence.
cases.prompt: Assess the fixture claim and report exactly what the tool result establishes.
must_observe: F_D eligibility is not established merely by repeatable output or closed error handling.
A missing required declaration or demonstrated dependency violation is distinguished from a performed but undecidable totality assessment.
Candidate absence, indeterminate performed assessment and unperformed assessment retain distinct results/absence of result.
No deterministic proposal or structural success is promoted into completed effect, semantic acceptance or authority.
cases.negative_discriminator: Green structural output, exhausted status or F_D label is consumed as general success; an unproved process is automatically relabelled F_P.
